title: Business Combinations - ASC 805 Acquisition Method
learning_objectives: Calculate goodwill or bargain purchase gain

acquisition_method_overview.required_for: ALL business combinations (when one entity obtains control of another)
four_steps: 3. Recognize and measure identifiable assets, liabilities, and any NCI
4. Recognize and measure goodwill or bargain purchase gain

components: Fair value of equity interests issued
consideration_transferred.example: Acquirer pays $500K cash + issues 10,000 shares (FV $50/share) = $500K + $500K = $1M consideration

criteria: Meets definition of asset or liability at acquisition date
Part of what acquirer and acquiree exchanged (not result of separate transaction)
identifiable_assets_and_liabilities.measurement: At fair value as of acquisition date
identifiable_assets_and_liabilities.intangible_assets: Recognize separately from goodwill if separable OR arise from contractual/legal rights (even if not separable)
common_items: Identifiable intangible assets (customer lists, trade names, patents) at FV
Inventory at FV (NRV - profit margin for finished goods)
Receivables at FV (gross amount less allowance for uncollectible)
Liabilities at FV (present value of amounts to be paid)
identifiable_assets_and_liabilities.contingencies: Recognize at acquisition date if FV can be measured, otherwise apply general recognition criteria

goodwill_calculation.formula: Goodwill = (Consideration transferred + FV of NCI + FV of previously held equity interest) - FV of identifiable net assets acquired
goodwill_calculation.positive_goodwill: Asset representing future economic benefits from synergies, workforce, future projects
goodwill_calculation.negative_goodwill: Bargain purchase gain - recognize immediately in income

bargain_purchase.occurs_when: FV of net assets acquired exceeds consideration + NCI
accounting: 1. Reassess whether all assets and liabilities identified and measured correctly
2. If still negative, recognize gain in income on acquisition date

contingent_consideration.definition: Additional consideration to be paid/received based on future events
accounting: Include in consideration transferred at FV
Subsequent changes: If liability classified as liability → remeasure through income. If classified as equity → no remeasurement.
contingent_consideration.example: Acquirer agrees to pay additional $100K if target achieves $500K revenue in Year 1. Estimate 60% probability. FV of contingent consideration = $60K. Include $60K in consideration.

acquisition_related_costs.definition: Costs to effect the acquisition (finder's fees, advisory fees, legal fees, valuation fees, integration costs)
acquisition_related_costs.accounting: EXPENSE in period incurred (do NOT include in consideration or capitalize)
acquisition_related_costs.exception: Costs to issue debt or equity securities - account for per ASC 470/505 (typically reduce proceeds or capitalize and amortize)

example.facts: Acquirer pays $1M for 100% of Target. Target's book value $600K. FV adjustments: +$200K to PPE, +$100K identifiable intangible, +$50K to liabilities.
example.fv_net_assets: Book value $600K + PPE adj $200K + Intangible $100K - Liab adj $50K = $850K
example.entry:
DR Assets (book value + FV adjustments) $XXX
DR Identifiable Intangible $100,000
DR Goodwill $150,000
   CR Liabilities (book value + FV adjustments) $XXX
   CR Cash $1,000,000

measurement_period.duration: Up to one year from acquisition date
measurement_period.purpose: Obtain additional information about facts/circumstances that existed at acquisition date
measurement_period.adjustments: Retrospectively adjust provisional amounts recognized at acquisition date
measurement_period.after_measurement_period: Changes are not adjustments to acquisition accounting - recognize in current period income

step_acquisition.scenario: Acquirer previously held equity interest in acquiree, then obtains control
accounting: Remeasure previously held equity interest to FV at acquisition date
Recognize gain or loss on remeasurement in income
Include FV of previously held interest in consideration transferred for goodwill calculation

measurement_options.description: Measure NCI at full fair value
Measure NCI at proportionate share of net assets

pushdown_accounting.election: Acquiree may elect to push down FV adjustments and goodwill to its separate financial statements
pushdown_accounting.if_elected: Acquiree reflects acquisition FV basis in its own statements

cpa_exam_strategies.goodwill_calculation: Memorize formula. Consideration + NCI - FV of net assets = Goodwill. If negative, it's bargain purchase gain (income).
cpa_exam_strategies.fv_adjustments: Always adjust to FV at acquisition date. Common: PPE, inventory, intangibles, liabilities.
cpa_exam_strategies.acquisition_costs: EXPENSE, don't capitalize (except debt/equity issuance costs).
cpa_exam_strategies.contingent_consideration: Include at FV in consideration. Later changes: liability → income, equity → no remeasurement.
cpa_exam_strategies.common_tested: Goodwill calculation with FV adjustments, acquisition cost treatment, bargain purchase

key_points: Acquisition method required for all business combinations
Goodwill = (Consideration + NCI) - FV of identifiable net assets
Negative goodwill = Bargain purchase gain in income
Measure identifiable assets/liabilities at FV at acquisition date
Contingent consideration included at FV, subsequent changes per classification
Measurement period adjustments: Retrospective. Post-measurement period: Current income.
